headline: UK Unemployment Dips but Small Businesses Reduce Hiring Over Labour Costs
summary: The UK unemployment rate declined, but small businesses are scaling back recruitment plans due to rising labour costs, according to data from the Office for National Statistics.
why: Small businesses account for a major portion of UK private employment, making their hiring intentions a leading gauge of wage pressures and overall economic momentum.

impacts.name: UK Small Business
impacts.why: High labour expenses are squeezing profit margins and forcing firms to restrain payroll growth.
